notes.title: Last Slice v1.1.0 - Helveti Joins the Fight!
notes.notes:
🐟Helveti Joins Last Slice🦈

This is the final update fixing some bugs, and adding a small ending after the final boss.

Thank you all for playing Last Slice!

Please also consider playing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1541250/Super_Raft_Boat/]Super Raft Boat[/url] and [url=https://opera.surveysparrow.com/s/GameMaker-Awards-2022/tt-ea38b2]voting[/url] for it for Best of GX Games in the Game Maker Awards!

[h2][h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1][/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Helveti from Super Raft Boat to party mode.
[*] Added epilogue in hub after beating final boss
[*] Added more people to credits
[*] Fixed UI scaling for party mode results screen
[*] Fixed level 2 wrong window
[*] Fixed level 2 intro typo
[*] Fixed TV object spin speed
[*] Cheezy's Fish and Pepperoni grow when hit
[*] Added dead zones (.25 - 1) for both controller sticks
[*] Digi Doggle white pixel fixed
[*] Fixed steam library placement
[*] High Drive song added
[*] Final Slice song added
[*] Fixed other small bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Last Slice: Steam Next Fest Stream
notes.notes:
Hello fellow slicers!

We've gotten a lot more done on the game since the last demo, so we're here to play it and have a good time streaming it!

notes.title: Last Slice: What's This?
notes.notes:
Imagine this… You're with your friends and you're all munching on some glorious pizza with a variety of toppings. You goof, you gaff, you're all having a grand ol’ time. You look up, and you realize that you and all of your friends are simultaneously reaching for the last slice! How could this happen?! There's only one thing to do of course.

In this party brawler, brutally fight each other and devour the last slice of pizza! But the longer the game goes, the weirder it gets...

On the flipside, play as a pizza deliverer in a single player campaign! Be on the lookout: there's tons of people out to get your pizza and stop you.
